original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
I woke up. I don't know how I made it after that battle, but I lived.

An Imperial woman sat beside me. She said she's an alchemist of sorts, found my body on the tundra. Damn giant got me good. It was nothing short of a miracle that I survived.

I told her I'm a mercenary and how I got there. She just nodded, said she might have a job for me with a whole chest of gold awaiting at the end. I don't know what that job is, but I know I owe her my life.
...
[pagebreak]
Woman wants me to lure the female Dunmer who work for the Company into their deaths. Pulled some strings on her lover to send them into my traps. I asked if she's got a vendetta against my kind - and why hire me if that's the case. She just said my scars from Hammerfell proved my innocence, that I must've been in Hammerfell the entire past decade for the scars to look like that. Who knew those pesky sand scorpions and their venom would one day save my life?

Anyway, she doesn't want them dead straight away - she has to know if they were involved in the death of someone named Alexius Peresta. Some guard in the Imperial City, she said. After I get the answer, I can do whatever I want to them.
...
[pagebreak]
Woman is apparently a master alchemist. She created the nastiest poison I've ever used. Must've used a love potion of some sort to seduce the Company guy too.

I do wonder how she managed to have her lover send Dunmer mercenaries to these 'jobs', but then I heard she's some kind of advocate for Dunmer recognition in Windhelm. Nice cover for someone who wants them dead. Company guy must've bought into that.

The first prey was a young one, came from Morrowind just ten years ago. I highly doubt she was the one who killed our guard, but I couldn't let her tell anyone about me.
...
[pagebreak]
The fifth prey thought she'd finally found a kindred spirit in the wolf den. I pitied her. Almost felt the same way, even... But I was paid.

By Azura, why hasn't the guard's killer surfaced yet?
...
[pagebreak]
Woman gave me an ointment today, said my skin would be smooth again in a few weeks.

I guess it'd be good to sleep without the bed grinding on my scars anymore.
...
[pagebreak]
The Company guy is starting to get suspicious, and my client is also getting impatient. We can't keep fooling around with every female Dunmer under his service. We need him to send his best into my trap, because that's most likely the one who killed Peresta.

Woman hatched this plan where I'd steal a prized antique from House Vici's vault down in Chorrol, then hand it to some loud-mouthed bandit clan in Skyrim. Company guy would surely fetch his best to retrieve it. Silverdrift Lair is where the bandits are holed up in.

She is doubling the pay this time, so who am I to argue about it?
...
[pagebreak]
Mephala take these bloody idiots! I told them not to touch the coffins, why didn't they listen?

Fine. Good thing the woman brewed a potion to make me smell like a Draugr. I guess I simply have to sneak past those things to hide the hammer.

The last prey wasn't it, either. Now I just have to wait for the next. Azura willing, this hunt will be over soon... one way or another.
</font>
string:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
我醒了过来。那场战斗之后我是怎么活下来的，我自己也说不清，但我终究是活了下来。

一位帝国女人坐在我身旁。她说自己算是个炼金术士，在苔原上发现了我的躯体。那该死的巨人下手真狠。我能活下来，简直是奇迹。

我告诉她我是个雇佣兵，以及我是怎么到那儿去的。她只是点点头，说也许有份活儿给我干，干完了有一整箱金币等着。我不知道那是什么活儿，但我知道我欠她一条命。
...
[pagebreak]
那女人要我把为公司做事的丹莫女人引向死路。她在自己的情人身上动了些手脚，好把她们送进我的陷阱。我问她是不是对我这族人有仇——若真是如此，又何必雇我。她只说我在落锤留下的伤疤足以证明我的清白，那些伤疤要长成那样，我过去十年必定一直待在落锤。谁能想到，那些烦人的沙蝎和它们的毒液，竟有一天救了我的命？

总之，她不想让她们立刻死——她必须先弄清楚她们是否参与了一个叫阿列克修斯·佩雷斯塔的人的死亡。她说那是帝都的一名卫兵。等我问出答案，我想怎么处置她们都行。
...
[pagebreak]
那女人显然是个用毒的行家。她调配出了我用过的最阴狠的毒药。她大概还用了某种爱情药水，把那公司的男人迷住了。

我确实好奇她怎么让自己的情人把丹莫佣兵一个个派去这些“活儿”，后来我听说她在风舵城为丹莫争取什么名分。对一个想要她们死的人来说，这伪装可真漂亮。公司那男人想必也信了。

第一个猎物很年轻，十年前才从晨风过来。我很清楚她不可能杀了我们那名卫兵，可我不能让她把我的事告诉任何人。
...
[pagebreak]
第五个猎物以为自己终于在狼窝里找到了同类。我可怜她。甚至几乎也有同样的感觉……可我是拿了钱的。

以阿祖拉之名，那卫兵的凶手为什么还不现身？
...
[pagebreak]
那女人今天给了我一罐药膏，说我的皮肤几周内就能恢复光滑。

我想，睡觉时床不再磨着我的伤疤，应该会好受些。
...
[pagebreak]
公司那男人开始起疑了，我的雇主也越来越不耐烦。我们不能一直在他手下每个丹莫女人身上打转。我们得让他把他最得力的那个派进我的陷阱，因为杀佩雷斯塔的多半就是她。

那女人想出了个计划：让我去科洛尔，从维齐家族的库房里偷走一件珍贵古物，再把它交给天际某个嗓门大的强盗团。公司那男人一定会派最得力的人去把它取回来。强盗们就盘踞在银流巢穴。

这次她把报酬翻了一倍，我还有什么好争的？
...
[pagebreak]
梅法拉降罪于这些该死的蠢货！我叫过他们别碰那些棺材，他们怎么就不听？

算了。好在那女人熬了一剂药水，让我闻起来像尸鬼。看来我只要从那些东西身边溜过去，把锤子藏好就行。

最后一个猎物也不是。现在我只能等下一个了。若阿祖拉愿意，这场猎杀很快就会结束……不管以哪种方式。
</font>

string: 近几个月里，公司雇的刀客已经失踪了六个。我要你把她们找出来。

original: Do these missing mercenaries have anything in common?
string: 这些失踪的佣兵有什么共同点吗？

original: Yes... They were all female Dunmer. Like you.
string: 有……她们都是女性丹莫。和你一样。

original: Curious choice of candidate for this task.
string: 这任务挑的候选人，可真有意思。

original: I would say a wise choice indeed. I suspect you'd be motivated to prevent more needless harm to your compatriots... or to you.
string: 我倒说挑得高明。我猜，你会很想阻止同族再受无谓的伤害……或者阻止伤到你自己。

original: One last job, and the Company will release you from your obligation.
string: 最后一桩差事，公司就免去你的义务。

original: Very well. I'll do it.
string: 好吧。我去做。

original: The last one was sent to Silverdrift Lair to retrieve a hammer stolen from our vault. It's been two weeks since we last heard of her. I suggest you start there.
string: 最后失踪的那个，是被派去银流巢穴取回从我们金库失窃的锤子。我们上次得到她的消息，已经过去两周了。我建议你从那里查起。

original: Missing mercenaries and ancient artifact... One last job, and I will be truly free.
string: 佣兵失踪，还有件古物……最后一桩差事，之后我就真正自由了。

original: It goes without saying. Don't forget the hammer.
string: 不必多言。别忘了那把锤子。

original: Orthus said only female Dunmer went missing. What do you make of that?
string: 奥苏斯说失踪的只有女性丹莫。你怎么看？

original: This land has never lacked for hateful Nords who despise my kind. But if it's them, why target only the women?
string: 这片土地从来不缺憎恶我族的诺德人。可若真是他们，为何只对女人下手？

original: The other possibility is that they abandoned their contracts and ran - but again, why only Dunmer women?
string: 另一种可能，是她们撇下合同跑了——但同样，为什么偏偏是丹莫女人？

original: I don't like this. They're exposing you to whatever's behind this.
string: 我不喜欢这样。他们这是在把你往幕后黑手跟前推。

original: Death is my business. Worry for them - not me.
string: 死亡是我的行当。该担心的是她们——不是我。

original: Think the Dunmer women are dead?
string: 你觉得那些丹莫女人已经死了吗？

original: Perhaps. But whether they yet live makes little difference to the Company.
string: 也许。但她们还是否活着，对公司来说没什么区别。

original: The Vici have no interest in failures.
string: 维齐家族对失败者没有兴趣。

original: We could still try to save them if there's a chance they still live.
string: 如果她们还活着，我们仍可以试着救她们。

original: We should focus on completing the task and getting you freed.
string: 我们该专心完成任务，让你脱身。

original: I suppose so.
string: 我想是吧。

original: Many people find Dunmer women attractive. Some among them are perverts.
string: 很多人觉得丹莫女人很有魅力。其中有些人是变态。

original: Then it will not be a Dunmer's skin they'll taste, but cold steel and the agony I will soon deliver.
string: 那他们尝到的就不会是丹莫的皮肤，而是冷钢，和我即将送上的痛楚。

original: Do you think the Company will truly let you go after this?
string: 你觉得这之后公司真会放你走吗？

original: The goldmongers are many things. Breakers of promises, they're not.
string: 那些金贩子毛病不少。背信弃义，他们倒不沾。

original: A sellsword's life is worth little to them. It is their service that matters - and every sellsword lost is a task left undone. A sunk cost rendered.
string: 对佣兵来说，一条命值不了几个钱。他们要的是效力——每折一个佣兵，就是一桩没了结的差事，一笔砸进去的成本。

original: Spend one so that ten stay valuable. Their calculation rarely fails.
string: 舍弃一个，好让十个仍然值钱。他们这笔账很少算错。

original: Looks like Silverdrift Lair is our only lead for now.
string: 看来眼下银流巢穴是唯一的线索了。

original: Indeed. But... I do have one question.
string: 不错。不过……我确实有个问题。

original: Why help me? You were the one who paid for my service.
string: 你为什么要帮我？当初出钱雇我的，就是你。

original: I want you to stay focused to my needs, not the Company's.
string: 我要你专注在我的需求上，而不是公司的。

original: You've become more than just a sellsword to me.
string: 你对我而言，已经不只是个佣兵了。

original: I see.
string: 我明白了。

original: I just don't like how the Company exploits people.
string: 我只是看不惯公司这样榨取别人。

original: Good. Then we shouldn't waste any time.
string: 那就好。我们不该再耽搁。

original: You're right. We can't risk this.
string: 你说得对。这个险不能冒。

original: A fair motivation.
string: 这话说得在理。

original: If it's death you bring, then do it. I will finally be reunited with my love... I only wish I could tell him that I've avenged him.
string: 若你是来取我性命的，那就动手吧。我终于能和我爱的人重逢了……只恨我没能亲口告诉他，我已经替他报了仇。

original: I've heard enough.
string: 我听够了。

original: Let's talk outside.
string: 出去再说吧。

original: ...Thank you.
string: ……谢谢。

original: That scheming little whore. And to think I finally found someone who wasn't after my status.
string: 那个算计人的小婊子。我还以为我终于遇到了一个不图我地位的人。

original: Thank you for your service. Now that we've uncovered the truth behind all this, you can consider Jenassa's debt written off.
string: 感谢你的效力。既然我们已经查清了这一切背后的真相，简拉萨的债，从此刻起一笔勾销。

original: This... this can't be! Mabella... She approached me just to hunt and kill the Dunmer mercenaries in the Company? How can I be so blind?
string: 这……这不可能！马贝拉……她接近我，就是为了在公司里猎杀丹莫佣兵？我怎么就这么瞎？

original: My reasons are my own.
string: 我的理由，与你无关。

original: Fair enough.
string: 那也说得过去。

original: To Silverdrift Lair then, whenever you are ready.
string: 那就去银流巢穴吧，你准备好就动身。

original: Damn Draugr... Orthus never said there'd be so many of them.
string: 该死的尸鬼……奥苏斯可没说会有这么多。

original: Well look. Company sent more folks to finish the job, didn't they?
string: 瞧瞧。公司又派人来收尾了，是吧？

original: Orthus sent us to investigate missing Dunmer mercenaries.
string: 奥苏斯派我们来查失踪的丹莫佣兵。

original: He did? Thought he'd send someone to investigate the hammer instead.
string: 他派你们来的？我还以为他会派人来找那把锤子。

original: Orthus sent us to find an ancient king's hammer.
string: 奥苏斯派我们来找一位古代国王的锤子。

original: Of course he did.
string: 那当然。

original: What did you just drink?
string: 你刚才喝的是什么？

original: I suppose Orthus wouldn't care. Bandits who took this crypt were hiding a whole stash of Skooma. Before the Draugr woke up and wiped them out anyway.
string: 奥苏斯大概也不在乎。占了这座墓穴的强盗藏了一整批斯库玛——反正后来尸鬼醒过来，把他们一窝端了。

original: And no, you can't have any, because I just drank the last bottle.
string: 还有，别想分一口，因为最后一瓶刚被我喝完了。

original: I'm still quite alive, as you can see. I just need to drink this to get back up.
string: 我还没死，你看得出来。我只要喝下这个就能爬起来。

original: Ah... much better. Now, let's go find that damn hammer. Take all the pay and credit if you want - I just want to get this over with.
string: 啊……好多了。走吧，去把那把该死的锤子找出来。工钱和功劳你全拿去都行——我只想把这事了结。

original: Orthus said you haven't reported for two weeks.
string: 奥苏斯说你两周没来报到了。

original: Look, I was busy trying to survive down here. Reporting to an bloody accountant was the least of my problems.
string: 听着，我正忙着在这底下活命呢。向一个混账会计汇报，我压根顾不上。

original: Alright, let's go.
string: 好，走吧。

original: 'The Company always gets what it wants.' Or so goes the saying. After you!
string: “公司想要的东西，从来都能得到。”俗话就是这么说的。你先请！

original: So, how long have you been working for the Company?
string: 那你在公司干了多久了？

original: Decades.
string: 几十年了。

original: That's pretty long. For me it was just a few years.
string: 那可够久的。我才干了几年。

original: What kind of jobs do you usually get? Mine's always clearing dungeons and finding dusty artifacts...
string: 你平时都接些什么活儿？我总是在清地牢、找落满灰的古物……

original: Right now, it's investigating missing mercenaries.
string: 眼下是查失踪的佣兵。

original: Huh. You ask me, those mercenaries probably ran off on their own. Live well with the fat purse they earned.
string: 呵。要我说，那些佣兵多半是自己跑了。拿着挣来的满袋金币，过得逍遥快活。

original: Gold drives some, but not all.
string: 有人是被金币驱使，但不是所有人。

original: Why else would you possibly work for those people? With all the dirty places they have us go to.
string: 那不然呢？他们派我们去的地方一个比一个脏。

original: A debt. One I have no choice but to repay.
string: 一笔债。我别无选择，只能还。

original: I do know another who'd kill for her debts. As much of a mess as you are, honestly.
string: 我倒还认识一个会为债去杀人的。说实话，跟你一样一团糟。

original: After I earn enough gold, I'm going to buy an estate in Cyrodiil. Might invite you lot over and show you around...
string: 等我攒够金币，我要去希罗帝尔置座庄园。说不定还请你们过来，带你们转转……

original: Oh, but have you been to Cyrodiil before?
string: 噢，你去过希罗帝尔吗？

original: It doesn't matter. Focus on the task.
string: 不重要。专心办事。

original: I used to run jobs in Cyrodiil, you see. Things surely can get ugly down south.
string: 我在希罗帝尔干过活儿，你知道的。南边那地方，事情总会闹得很难看。

original: Killed an Imperial officer for the Company, for instance.
string: 比方说，为公司杀过一名帝国军官。

original: What are you trying to say?
string: 你到底想说什么？

original: Oh, but what's the matter. The Imperials have never cared much for our people. Their coin is the only thing that drives us.
string: 噢，这有什么。帝国人从来就没把我们当回事。我们图的不过是他们的钱。

original: Surely you wouldn't mind killing a few self-righteous fools who get in our employer's way.
string: 想必你也不介意杀掉几个自以为是、挡了雇主路的蠢货吧。

original: Hammer has to be up ahead. Be ready for the Draugr.
string: 锤子应该就在前面。准备好对付尸鬼。

original: Of course you know.
string: 你当然是知道的。

original: What do you know about the missing mercenaries?
string: 关于那些失踪的佣兵，你知道些什么？

original: Mercenaries are missing? No clue... But that gives us a damn good reason to stick together.
string: 有佣兵失踪？没听说……不过这倒给了我们一个抱团的好理由。

original: Now the odds are even... Let's start talking, mercenary. Then we'll see about your little friend.
string: 现在双方势均力敌了……我们开始谈谈吧，佣兵。然后再说说你那位小朋友。

original: Now the odds are even. Let's start talking, mercenary.
string: 现在双方势均力敌了。开始谈谈吧，佣兵。

original: You aren't really hired by Orthus, are you?
string: 你根本不是奥苏斯雇来的，对吧？

original: Five years ago, an Imperial guard named Alexius Peresta was murdered; his house was burned down along with the evidence he'd gathered to incriminate the Company.
string: 五年前，一名叫阿列克修斯·佩雷斯塔的帝国卫兵遭人谋杀；他的宅子被烧毁，连同他收集来指控公司的证据一起。

original: It was you, wasn't it? I could tell from the way you flinched back there.
string: 是你干的，对吧？刚才你那一缩就露馅了。

original: That's between me and the guard, and he's dead. Who do you work for? What do you want here?!
string: 那是我和那个卫兵之间的账，他已经死了。你替谁做事？你来这里想干什么？！

original: Rest assured, it was nothing personal. We both work for our debts after all.
string: 放心，这不带私人恩怨。说到底，我们都只是为了各自的债在做事。

original: If it's any solace, no more of our kind need to die by my hand after this.
string: 若这能让你好受些，这之后再也不必有我族类死于我手。

original: Oh, by the way. The thing I drank back there? It wasn't Skooma.
string: 噢，顺便说一句。我刚才喝的那东西？不是斯库玛。

original: The ghosts of the past return to haunt us all, sooner or later.
string: 往昔的幽魂迟早会回来缠上我们每一个人。

original: Did you find anything?
string: 你找到什么了吗？

original: I remember this. You said you killed an Imperial guard by the Vici's order.
string: 我记得这段。你说过，你奉维齐家族之命杀了一名帝国卫兵。

original: Murdered. As was required by those I owed.
string: 是谋杀。是我欠债的那些人要求的。

original: What has always been happening.
string: 一直都是这样的事。

original: We can talk about that later. Right now, we have other priorities.
string: 那我们可以之后再谈。眼下还有更要紧的事。

original: What exactly happened in Cyrodiil?
string: 希罗帝尔那边究竟发生了什么？

original: Would you like to talk about what happened in Cyrodiil now?
string: 现在你想谈谈希罗帝尔那件事吗？

original: The East Empire Company - or the Vici family, to be precise - wanted a specific Imperial officer killed, and they required someone not from Cyrodiil.
string: 东帝国公司——确切地说，是维齐家族——想除掉一名特定的帝国军官，而且需要一个不是希罗帝尔出身的人。

original: Looks like the other mercenaries met their ends at the one we just killed.
string: 看来其他佣兵都死在我们刚杀掉的那个手上。

original: The Three will take them if they remained true to our faith. A meaning is all we can grant to their deaths.
string: 只要她们忠于我们的信仰，三神自会接纳她们。对她们的死，我们能赋予的也就只有意义了。

original: We need to find this mercenary's employer, or they will keep hunting you.
string: 我们得找出这名佣兵的雇主，否则他们还会继续追杀你。

original: I believe... I think I know who they are. I just don't know where.
string: 我相信……我想我知道他们是谁。只是不知道他们在哪里。

original: Maybe the mercenary has a clue on her.
string: 也许这名佣兵身上有线索。

original: Let's search her body then.
string: 那就搜她的尸体。

original: Not yet.
string: 先不急。

original: The lengths we both went to avenge our loved ones.
string: 我们俩为了给所爱之人复仇，都走到了这一步。

original: Take me back to Orthus. This pursuit is near its end.
string: 带我回奥苏斯那儿去。这场追查快到尽头了。

original: I found this journal.
string: 我找到了这本日记。

original: What then?
string: 然后呢？

original: We'll learn where his mistress is. Then I'll confront her.
string: 我们会弄清他的情妇在哪里。然后我去跟她当面对质。

original: I don't know what will happen when we meet... but I've owed it to her.
string: 我不知道见面后会怎样……但我欠她一个交代。

original: Or we can just tell Orthus his mistress was behind the Dunmer's deaths.
string: 或者我们直接告诉奥苏斯，那些丹莫的死都是他情妇干的。

original: We can. But not until I meet her.
string: 可以。但得等我先见到她。

original: What difference will that make? His mistress wants you dead.
string: 那又能有什么不同？他情妇想置你于死地。

original: And rightly so. But no matter how this all unfolds in the end... I owe this woman closure.
string: 理应如此。可不管最后如何收场……我欠这个女人一个了结。

original: Promise me you won't let any harm come to yourself.
string: 答应我，别让自己受任何伤害。

original: If she dares use her weapon, I will slit her throat.
string: 她要是敢动兵器，我就割了她的喉咙。

original: Alright, let's return to Orthus.
string: 好，我们回奥苏斯那儿。

original: We know you have a mistress. We need to know where she is.
string: 我们知道你有个情妇。我们得知道她在哪里。

original: Oh. That's... unexpected. But it begs the question - how does that assist your current task?
string: 哦。这可……出乎意料。但话又说回来——这对你眼下的任务有什么助益？

original: The one behind the Dunmer mercenaries' deaths is after her too. (Lie)
string: 那些丹莫佣兵之死的幕后黑手，也盯上了她。（谎称）

original: Dead? Oh. That's unfortunate... Might I ask how you learned of this?
string: 死了？哦。那可真不幸……可否问问，你是怎么得知的？

original: Your mistress was the one behind the Dunmer mercenaries' deaths.
string: 你的情妇就是那些丹莫佣兵之死的幕后黑手。

original: Impossible! My Mabella could never plot something so atrocious. I should have you removed from this office immediately!
string: 不可能！我的马贝拉绝不会谋划这种丧尽天良的事。我该立刻叫人把你赶出这间办公室！

original: (Show him Wylarun's journal)
string: （给他看威拉伦的日记）

original: (Show him Wylarun's journal)
string: （给他看威拉伦的日记）

original: What? But it says... It says Mabella is behind all this?
string: 什么？可这上面写着……写着马贝拉是这一切的幕后主使？

original: By Zenithar! She approached me just to hunt and kill our Dunmer mercenaries! How can I be so blind?
string: 泽尼萨尔在上！她接近我，就是为了猎杀我们公司的丹莫佣兵！我怎么就这么瞎？

original: I fought the mercenary who killed those Dunmer, but more are still around. (Lie)
string: 我和杀害那些丹莫的佣兵交过手，但她的同伙还在。（谎称）

original: But... why Mabella? What could possibly connect her to... this?
string: 可是……为什么是马贝拉？她和这些人……能有什么牵连？

original: No time to explain. You just have to believe me. She is in peril! (Persuade)
string: 没时间解释。你只能相信我。她有危险！（说服）

original: You're right. Questions can wait - her safety is more important.
string: 你说得对。疑问可以之后再问——她的安全更要紧。

original: As much as I care about her, I won't believe any tale spinned by an adventurer.
string: 我虽然在意她，但也不会相信一个冒险者编出来的故事。

original: But I would rather not risk her safety over this.
string: 但我也不愿为这事拿她的安危去赌。

original: She advocates for Dunmer recognition, making her the Nords' target. (Persuade)
string: 她替丹莫争取权益，已经成了诺德人的眼中钉。（说服）

original: By Zenithar, I will send the Company soldiers at my disposal to guard her day and night!
string: 泽尼萨尔在上，我这就派手下能调动的公司士兵日夜守着她！

original: It's best not to alert those killers. Let me handle this. (Persuade)
string: 最好不要惊动那些杀手。交给我来处理。（说服）

original: Nonsense. The East Empire Company has access to the finest weapons and fighters in Tamriel. They will do their job professionally.
string: 荒唐。东帝国公司手里有泰姆瑞尔最好的武器和战士。他们会办得漂漂亮亮。

original: The higher-ups won't like you using Company resources for your lover. (Persuade)
string: 上头不会喜欢你拿公司的资源护着自己的情人。（说服）

original: You're right... If they hear of this, they'll take this office from me.
string: 你说得对……要是他们听说了，这间办公室就要从我手里收走。

original: One of them could be working for whoever is behind this. (Persuade)
string: 他们里头可能有人正替幕后主使做事。（说服）

original: Against the wealth and status the Company could offer them? Don't be ridiculous.
string: 拿他们去赌公司能给他们的财势？别荒唐了。

original: The serial murderer of Windhelm had help. He's after more women. (Persuade)
string: 风舵城那个连环凶手有帮手。他还盯上了更多女人。（说服）

original: You... you were the one who found out about that 'Butcher', weren't you? If what you're saying is true...
string: 你……当初揪出那个“屠夫”的就是你，对吧？如果你说的是真的……

original: It's decided. I'll have my men protect Mabella until you find out this... murderer.
string: 就这么定了。我派人护着马贝拉，直到你查出那个……凶手。

original: Mabella is staying with my friend Viola Giordano. Be quick, she needs to be warned!
string: 马贝拉住在我朋友维欧拉·乔尔丹诺家里。快去，得警告她！

original: Agreed, that'll keep her safe.
string: 好，这样她就安全了。

original: Thank you for your service. Now, continue your search. Jenassa's task isn't over until this murderer is brought to justice.
string: 感谢你的效力。现在，继续追查吧。不把这个凶手绳之以法，简拉萨的任务就不算完。

original: You bloody imbecile! Now his soldiers will get her before we do!
string: 你这个混账蠢货！现在他的士兵会赶在我们前头抓到她！

original: We could both have had closure. But now she will die with her hatred and I with my regrets. All thanks to you.
string: 我们本来都能有个了结。可现在她带着恨去死，我带着悔去死。全拜你所赐。

original: You tried your best. But now we have a few Company soldiers to deal with.
string: 你已经尽力了。可现在我们有几名公司士兵要应付。

original: Well done. Now we just have to find this 'Mabella' in Giordano's house.
string: 干得好。现在我们只消去乔尔丹诺家的宅子里找出这个“马贝拉”。

original: She has killed too many Dunmer. She must be brought to justice.
string: 她杀的丹莫太多了。必须把她绳之以法。

original: May you be proud of yourself then, oh you righteous.
string: 那你就为自己骄傲吧，噢，你这正义之士。

original: Come on. The debt's gone, but our contract remains.
string: 走吧。债没了，合同还在。

original: I'm sorry. I just didn't know what I was doing.
string: 对不起。我只是不知道自己在做什么。

original: I hope you know what your ignorance has cost us both.
string: 我希望你明白，你的无知让我们俩付出了什么代价。

original: What else did you expect to happen? She'd walk free and you'd soothe your guilt?
string: 你还指望会怎样？她全身而退，你好宽慰自己的愧疚？

original: What I expected was... It's no longer important.
string: 我原本期望的是……已经不重要了。

original: She wanted to kill you. We can't take any chances.
string: 她想杀你。我们冒不起这个险。

original: I would be more than capable to defend myself. But I guess we'll never know now, no?
string: 我完全有能力自保。不过看来我们永远也不会知道了，对吧？

original: We can just kill those soldiers so that you can talk.
string: 那些士兵直接杀掉就行，你就能好好谈了。

original: If it comes to that. But we needn't take unnecessary risks.
string: 若真到了那一步。但我们不必冒不必要的风险。

original: We still don't know where she is. It's a dead end.
string: 我们还是不知道她在哪。这条线索断了。

original: Not yet. We still have time to find this 'Mabella'.
string: 还没有。我们还有时间找到这个“马贝拉”。

original: The journal says she advocates for Dunmer recognition. Perhaps some of my brethren will know where she is.
string: 日记里说她在替丹莫争取权益。也许我的同胞里有谁知道她在哪。

original: Or we could knock on every door in Windhelm... But that sounds like madness to me.
string: 或者我们去风舵城挨家挨户敲门……但那听起来像是疯了。

original: Alright, let's go.
string: 好，走吧。

original: I'm friends with Viola. I can get in without issue.
string: 我和维欧拉是朋友。我可以直接进去。

original: Viola is dead. We should get in without issue.
string: 维欧拉死了。我们应该能顺利进去了。

original: Nothing we aren't unfamiliar with.
string: 也不是我们没经历过的事。

original: We may have to break in.
string: 也许我们得破门而入。

original: After you.
string: 你先请。

original: What do you expect there?
string: 你指望在那儿找到什么？

original: Closure.
string: 了结。

original: Stop right there! What are you doing? This house is off-limits.
string: 站住！你在做什么？这座宅子不准进入。

original: Is this how you treat this house's owner? I'm married to Viola.
string: 你们就是这样对待房主的？我和维欧拉是夫妻。

original: Oh, forgive me. Lady Giordano did mention you. Please, ignore us - it's just East Empire business.
string: 噢，恕罪。乔尔丹诺女士提过你。请随意吧，我们只是在办东帝国公司的公务。

original: I think Lady Giordano is in Candlehearth. Mister Endario's treat. Why don't you go find her there?
string: 我想乔尔丹诺女士在烛炉堂。恩达里奥先生请客。你何不去那儿找她？

original: I'm Viola's friend. I'm just here to visit her.
string: 我是维欧拉的朋友。我只是来拜访她。

original: Just let me through.
string: 让我过去就好。

original: Stay out of Company business, if you know what's good for you.
string: 识相的话，就别插手公司的事。

original: Will some gold change your mind? (Bribe)
string: 一些金币能让你改主意吗？（贿赂）

original: Think our loyalty to the Company is so cheap? Just a few more years, and I'll get a promotion. Higher places await. Nothing you pay is worth it.
string: 你以为我们对公司的忠心这么便宜？再熬几年我就要升职了。更高的位置等着我。你出多少钱都不值。

original: Believe me. It is well worth it. (10000 gold)
string: 相信我。这可值太多了。（10000 金币）

original: To Oblivion with the promotion, they ain't ever paying me this much more anyway.
string: 升职见鬼去吧，反正他们从来不会给我加这么多钱。

original: Lads! Company officer here is treating us all to a night in Candlehearth!
string: 弟兄们！公司这位长官要请我们全体去烛炉堂喝一整晚！

original: Don't you dare tell them how much you gave me.
string: 你可别告诉他们你给了我多少。

original: Probably not.
string: 大概不行。

original: I helped the Company fight the pirates on Japhet's Folly. Don't you remember?
string: 我在贾菲特之愚帮公司打过海盗。你不记得了？

original: Came here after that. Haven't heard about you.
string: 我打那之后才来这儿。没听说过你。

original: (Attack)
string: （攻击）

original: Soldiers! We're under attack!
string: 士兵们！我们被袭击了！

original: And so I see your face again. No longer obfuscated by smoke, this time.
string: 于是我又见到了你的脸。这次不再被浓烟遮住了。

original: Mabella... Wife of Alexius Peresta.
string: 马贝拉……阿列克修斯·佩雷斯塔的妻子。

original: Keep my husband's name off your tongue. The man whose life you took so cold-bloodedly.
string: 少用你那张嘴提我丈夫的名字。你那么冷血地夺走了他的命。

original: You're here. It means Wylarun is dead, isn't she? Pity. All the lives she'd claimed, only to fail at the one she should've taken.
string: 你来了。这说明威拉伦死了，对不对？可惜。她夺了那么多条命，偏偏该拿的那条没能拿到。

original: She was just a tool to you, wasn't she?
string: 对你来说，她不过是个工具，对吧？

original: I paid her. Isn't that what you mercenary type do? Take the contract, kill the target. No questions asked.
string: 我付了她钱。不就是你们佣兵干的事吗？接下合同，杀掉目标。不问缘由。

original: Even when your target never wanted more than to save lives.
string: 哪怕你下手的目标，从来只想多救几条命。

original: I'm sorry.
string: 对不起。

original: And who are you? Does the mercenary not wish to dirty her hand, that she hired you to finish me instead?
string: 那你又是谁？这佣兵是不愿脏了自己的手，才雇你来替她结果我？

original: No. I was the one who hired her, but I am here as her friend.
string: 不。雇她的人是我，但我来这里，是以朋友的身份。

original: Ah. So you grew close to this sellsword - someone whose smile is sold as easily as her loyalty. A tragic mistake.
string: 啊。所以你跟这个卖剑的亲近起来了——一个笑容和忠心一样随手可卖的人。真是可悲的错误。

original: Did you kill all those Dunmer mercenaries?
string: 那些丹莫佣兵，都是你杀的？

original: I didn't. It was Wylarun's work - all I required was your friend's head.
string: 不是我。那是威拉伦的手笔——我要的，只是你朋友的脑袋。

original: It wasn't my fault the mercenary was so eager to prove she was earning my pay.
string: 那佣兵急着证明自己配得上我的钱，可不是我的错。

original: How did you find out about Jenassa?
string: 你是怎么查到简拉萨的？

original: She thought saving me from that fire would absolve her of her sins. All that did was let me see her face.
string: 她以为把我从那场火里救出来，就能洗清自己的罪孽。结果只是让我看清了她的脸。

original: Regrettably, the smoke was so thick, I could only make out she was a Dunmer woman. Six lives taken needlessly because of that.
string: 遗憾的是烟太浓，我只能看出那是个丹莫女人。六条命就这样白白送了。

original: The things I let that Company bastard do to me every night... just so I could have my revenge... Can you even imagine that?
string: 那些夜里，我任凭公司那混蛋对我做的事……只为了能报仇……你能想象吗？

original: So what do you plan to do now?
string: 那你打算怎么办？

original: She took the love of my life. What do you think I plan to do?
string: 她夺走了我一生的挚爱。你说我打算怎么办？

original: But it's you killers against an unarmed woman in this room. That idiot's soldiers would never make it here in time... I know it.
string: 但这屋里是你们这些杀手，对着一个手无寸铁的女人。那蠢货的士兵赶不来的……我知道。

original: You're clever, disposing of that idiot's soldiers. Now it's you killers against an unarmed woman.
string: 你真聪明，把那个蠢货的士兵都处理掉了。现在这屋里是你们这些杀手，对着一个手无寸铁的女人。

original: Whatever I may have planned, it's now you killers against an unarmed woman. How else could this possibly end?
string: 不管我原本打算做什么，现在这屋里都是你们这些杀手，对着一个手无寸铁的女人。这还能怎么收场？

original: Your hatred has caused too many deaths. You cannot be forgiven. (Attack)
string: 你的仇恨已经害死了太多人。你不可能被宽恕。（攻击）

original: You want to harm Jenassa. I can't let you. (Attack)
string: 你想伤害简拉萨。我不能让你得逞。（攻击）

original: Have you ever heard of a woman called Mabella?
string: 你听说过一个叫马贝拉的女人吗？

original: Her? Aye. She's rather friendly for an Imperial. Think she visited the Cornerclub with Viola Giordano a few times too.
string: 她？认识。对一个帝国人来说，她算是相当和气。好像还跟维欧拉·乔尔丹诺一起去过几趟街角吧。

original: Jenassa wasn't the one who gave the order.
string: 下命令的不是简拉萨。

original: But she was their weapon. Isn't that right? A sellsword who sold her blade and her soul to the highest bidder?
string: 可她是他们的刀。不是吗？一个把剑和灵魂都卖给出价最高者的佣兵？

original: You're wrong, and you know it.
string: 你错了，你自己也知道。

original: Your husband died fighting corruption, yet you chase petty revenge.
string: 你丈夫为对抗腐败而死，你却在追逐一场小小的私仇。

original: My husband... Alexius believed in his fight. And it cost him his life.
string: 我丈夫……阿列克修斯相信自己所做的事。而为此丢了性命。

original: I wish I was brave like him. Even if it would end the same way.
string: 我希望自己能像他那样勇敢。哪怕结局还是一样。

original: You chose the easy fight, against Jenassa instead of the system that killed him.
string: 你挑了容易的那场仗来打——找上简拉萨，而不是害死他的那个体制。

original: What could I have done? I am not him... I am not Alexius.
string: 我又能做什么？我不是他……我不是阿列克修斯。

original: Jenassa saved your life. How could you be so ungrateful?
string: 简拉萨救了你的命。你怎么能如此不知感激？

original: So I should be grateful to my husband's murderer?
string: 所以我该感激杀我丈夫的凶手？

original: Think wisely. You have a chance to walk away if you just let things go.
string: 想清楚。你只要放下这一切，还有机会走开。

original: And I refuse to let him go.
string: 而我拒绝放下他。

original: You've said nothing but insults to me and my husband's memory. I will have no more of it.
string: 你除了侮辱我和我丈夫的回忆，没说过别的话。我不想再听了。

original: Do you think I am ignorant to that fact? That I was wasting my life on a hunt that would've changed nothing?
string: 你以为我不知道吗？不知道我是在为一场什么都改变不了的猎杀浪费生命？

original: Hunting the one who dealt the blow, it was... it was the one thing I could do.
string: 去追那个下杀手的人，那是我……我唯一能做的事。

original: There are other ways to honor your husband's memory.
string: 还有别的办法可以纪念你的丈夫。

original: And what are they?
string: 那是什么办法？

original: Admit it. You're just doing this to make yourself feel better.
string: 承认吧。你做这些，只是为了让自己好受些。

original: It wasn't what my husband would've wanted.
string: 那并不是我丈夫想要的。

original: I'm sorry, Alexius... I don't think I know any other way. Not anymore.
string: 对不起，阿列克修斯……我大概已经不知道还有别的路了。

original: Hunting her changes nothing. It's not the fight your husband would've fought.
string: 追猎她什么都改变不了。那并不是你丈夫会打的仗。

original: No... He would've struck at the beast's head.
string: 不……他会直取那头野兽的首级。

original: Forget your hatred. Live happily, start an alchemy shop somewhere.
string: 忘掉你的仇恨吧。好好过日子，找个地方开家炼金铺子。

original: I... I don't know. But... I guess I'll see.
string: 我……我不知道。不过……我想我会看着办的。

original: Thank you.
string: 谢谢。

original: Continue your husband's battle. Fight the system that got him killed.
string: 继续你丈夫的仗。去斗那个害死他的体制。

original: I know who gave the orders. I just didn't have the evidence...
string: 我知道是谁下的令。我只是没有证据……

original: Before Alexius's death, he was investigating the East Empire Company's accounts. Earned him the ire of the Vici family.
string: 阿列克修斯死前，正在查东帝国公司的账目。这让他招来了维齐家族的怨恨。

original: The fire consumed all the evidence he'd found... but I have something he didn't. The trust of a Company fool. He's my way in.
string: 那场火烧掉了他找到的全部证据……但我有他没有的东西。一个公司蠢货的信任。他是我进门的钥匙。

original: I don't know if I'll ever forgive you, mercenary. But I... have a better path than to hate you. At least, I hope.
string: 我不知道自己会不会有一天原谅你，佣兵。但我……有一条比恨你更好的路。至少，我希望如此。

original: I sincerely hope you do. Mabella Peresta.
string: 我真心希望你能做到。马贝拉·佩雷斯塔。

original: Come on. Let's leave this place.
string: 走吧。我们离开这儿。

original: I'm glad you helped Mabella see a different way. I... I've owed her that much.
string: 我很高兴你帮马贝拉看清了另一条路。我……我欠她的。

original: That's another debt you've helped me repay. At this point, I suspect I owe you more than anyone else.
string: 这是你帮我偿还的又一份债。到如今，我猜我欠你比欠谁都多。

original: Seeing Mabella die like this... I should feel safe now. But there's nothing but woe and regret in my heart.
string: 看着马贝拉这样死去……我本该感到安全了。可我心里只剩下悲苦和悔恨。

original: Why did you do this?! Mabella and I could have had our closure, but you just have to be the smart one and ruin it, don't you?
string: 你为什么要这么做？！马贝拉和我本来可以有个了结，可你非要当那个聪明人，把事情毁了，是不是？

original: I hope Azura turns her back on you whenever you need her. I only wish I could too, had I not been bound by our contract.
string: 我希望阿祖拉在你需要她时背过身去。要不是受合同所缚，我但愿自己也能如此。

original: Speaking of which... Your debt to the East Empire Company...
string: 说到这个……你欠东帝国公司的那笔债……

original: Mabella may have orchestrated all this, but I owe her the chance to live a new life.
string: 这一切也许是马贝拉谋划的，但我欠她一个重新生活的机会。

original: If that means I must remain indebted to the Vici, then so be it.
string: 如果这意味着我要继续欠着维齐家族，那就这样吧。

original: Now that Mabella is dead... I suppose there's no point hiding her role in those deaths anymore.
string: 既然马贝拉已经死了……我想再隐瞒她在这几桩命案里的角色也没意义了。

original: Tell Orthus the truth. I'll be free from this debt for good.
string: 把真相告诉奥苏斯。我就能彻底从这笔债里脱身。

original: You see yourself in her. Someone who destroyed herself to avenge her loved one.
string: 你从她身上看见了自己。一个为了给所爱之人报仇，把自己毁掉的人。

original: I do.
string: 确实。

original: But someone was there to catch me, even as I fell into darkness.
string: 但即便我落入黑暗时，也有人在那里接住了我。

original: Sooner or later, they'll have you kill another Alexius, create another Mabella.
string: 迟早有一天，他们会让你再杀一个阿列克修斯，再逼出一个马贝拉。

original: If not me, then it would've simply been someone else.
string: 就算不是我，也总会有别人。

original: 'The Company always gets what it wants.'
string: “公司想要的东西，从来都能得到。”

original: Then you'll simply have more blood debts on your hand. You can't repay them all.
string: 那你手上只会多出更多血债。你还也还不完。

original: I already carry one debt I can never repay... What's a few more to add to the list?
string: 我已经背着一笔这辈子还不清的债了……再多添几笔又算得了什么？

original: I appreciate all you've done to help me. But at this point... I think I just have to learn to live with the chain.
string: 我很感激你为我做的一切。可到了这一步……我想我只能学着与这条锁链共存了。

original: Or we could tell Orthus the truth. You'll win back your freedom.
string: 或者我们可以把真相告诉奥苏斯。你就能重新赢得自由。

original: In exchange of Mabella's.
string: 拿马贝拉的命去换。

original: It's not negotiable.
string: 这没得商量。

original: If that is truly what you wish.
string: 如果那真是你所愿。

original: As you wish. (Lie)
string: 如你所愿。（谎称）

original: I trust you have meaningful news?
string: 想必你带来了要紧的消息？

original: Your mistress Mabella was behind the mercenary deaths. (Show Wylaryn's journal)
string: 你的情妇马贝拉就是那些佣兵之死的幕后主使。（出示威拉伦的日记）

original: Mabella tried to attack me when I uncovered the truth. She's dead now.
string: 我揭穿真相时，马贝拉想杀我。她现在死了。

original: Shed no tears for the liar. She deserved worse.
string: 别为那个骗子流泪。她的下场还该更惨。

original: The Empire's justice, what else.
string: 帝国的律法，还能是什么。

original: What will happen to her?
string: 她会怎么样？

original: I may have been forced to kill a few Company soldiers to get to her...
string: 为了见到她，我恐怕不得不动手杀了几名公司的士兵……

original: Oh, that's unfortunate. I suppose we'll just have to deduct compensation for their families from your pay.
string: 噢，那可真不幸。看来只能从你的报酬里扣掉给他们家人的抚恤了。

original: That's it? That's all they were worth to you?
string: 就这样？他们对你来说就值这么多？

original: My friend, of the few things that the Company may lack for, headcount isn't one of them.
string: 朋友，公司或许缺很多东西，但从不缺人头。

original: But skilled workers like you, Jenassa, and the Dunmer mercenaries killed by Mabella's scheme? That, we would always appreciate.
string: 可像你这样熟练的干才、简拉萨，还有被马贝拉那套计划害死的丹莫佣兵？这些是我们永远都稀罕的。

original: I should go.
string: 我该走了。

original: Oh, before you go... Might I ask if you recovered the antique from Silverdrift Lair?
string: 噢，走之前……可否问一句，你在银流巢穴找到那件古物了吗？

original: Here it is.
string: 在这儿。

original: Thank you. I hope the Vici will appreciate all the effort we've taken for their collection. Here's your reward - and a little extra.
string: 谢谢你。希望维齐家族能体察我们为他们的收藏费了多少心力。这是你的报酬——外加一点额外的。

original: Sorry, I couldn't find it. (Lie)
string: 抱歉，我没找到。（谎称）

original: What pity. I suppose that means your reward is forfeit then.
string: 真可惜。看来你的报酬也就无从谈起了。

original: We couldn't find the killer behind this. (Lie)
string: 我们查不出这背后的凶手。（谎称）

original: All the time the Company has invested on you, and you tell me you're producing no result?
string: 公司在你身上投入了这么多时间，你就回报我一句毫无结果？

original: At least Jenassa will continue her bright career with us. I can't say the same for you.
string: 至少简拉萨还能留在我们这里继续她的光明前程。至于你，我就不好说了。

original: Now, give me one good news please. The hammer. Did you find it in Silverdrift Lair?
string: 现在，说个好消息给我听吧。那把锤子。你在银流巢穴找到了吗？

original: Here it is.
string: 在这儿。

original: You aren't completely useless after all. Good. Now begone, I have accounts to balance, and workers to supervise.
string: 你终究还不算一无是处。很好。现在滚吧，我还要平账，还要看着手下的工人。

original: No, I couldn't find it. (Lie)
string: 不，我没找到。（谎称）

original: Zenithar seems to have cursed the day we met, then.
string: 那看来泽尼萨尔诅咒了我们相识的那一天。

original: Now begone. I have accounts to balance, workers to supervise, and mistakes to rectify. Mistakes like yours, if I might be so honest.
string: 现在滚吧。我还要平账，还要看着手下的工人，还要纠正错误。要我说实话，就是像你这样的错误。

original: I told you not to. Why?
string: 我跟你说过别这么做的。为什么？

original: I suppose that's done.
string: 我想这就了结了。

original: I thought I would never find someone who understands. Not anymore... How glad am I to be proven wrong.
string: 我以为我再也找不到能理解我的人。再也找不到……真高兴我错了。

original: You may not appreciate it, but I did this for you. You're free now.
string: 你也许不领情，但我这么做是为了你。你现在自由了。

original: You have merely swapped one debt for another. And this other debt... that which I had a chance to repay... will be branded in my soul forever.
string: 你不过是把一笔债换成了另一笔。而这另一笔债……那笔我本有机会偿还的债……将永远烙在我灵魂里。

original: Let's go. You and I still have a contract to complete.
string: 走吧。你我还有一纸合同要完成。

original: Am I? Mabella's face is still clear before me. That face of pure wrath and hatred... as she drew her last breath.
string: 是吗？马贝拉的脸还清清楚楚地在我眼前。那张满是愤怒与仇恨的脸……就在她咽下最后一口气的时候。

original: One debt paid, yet the other will remain forever.
string: 一笔债还了，另一笔将永远留着。

original: Now you're truly free.
string: 现在你真正自由了。

original: Can anyone ever be happy with a chain on her neck?
string: 脖子上套着锁链的人，怎么可能真的快活？

original: I suppose the better term is... 'relieved'. I set out to free myself from the Company; yet in the process, I've won freedom from something greater.
string: 我想更贴切的说法是……松了口气。我本是为了从公司手里脱身，结果却从更沉重的东西里赢得了自由。

original: The Vici will yet give me another impossible task, and I will be obliged to complete it.
string: 维齐家族日后还会给我派不可能的差事，而我也只能去办。

original: But in this moment... in this moment, I am free.
string: 但在此刻……在此刻，我是自由的。

original: Are you happy?
string: 你快活吗？

original: We all know our places in this world. Those who don't are destined to be swept away by the waves.
string: 我们都清楚自己在这世上该站的位置。不清楚的人，注定被浪头卷走。

original: Mabella...
string: 马贝拉……

original: ...The Company always gets what it wants.
string: ……公司想要的东西，从来都能得到。

original: This voice promises reward. One can only wonder what its nature is.
string: 这声音许诺着报酬。谁也猜不透它究竟是什么。

original: These bandits take their payment either way, whether you have gold or not.
string: 不管你身上有没有金币，这些强盗都照收不误。

original: Give my armor back. It's freezing out here.
string: 把我的护甲还给我。这外面冷得要命。

original: Give me back my armor. Now.
string: 把我的护甲还给我。马上。

original: Enjoying what you see?
string: 看得开心吗？

original: It's only fair if you also let me see yourself.
string: 那你也让我看看你，才叫公平。

original: Now we see each other for who we are.
string: 现在我们都看清了彼此真正的样子。

original: You're making a fool of yourself.
string: 你这是在出自己的丑。

original: By Azura, you should get something to wear. It's freezing out here.
string: 以阿祖拉之名，你该找件衣服穿。这外面冷得要命。

original: No one needs to see that right now.
string: 这东西现在可没人想看。

original: Cover yourself. Everyone is looking at you.
string: 遮起来。所有人都在看你。

original: Cover yourself. What you show is meant for my eyes alone.
string: 遮起来。你露出来的东西，只该让我一个人看。

original: You smell foul. Like you're rotting from within.
string: 你身上味道难闻。像是从里面开始烂了。

original: You look ill. Better keep your distance.
string: 你气色很糟。最好离远点。

original: Are things alright? You look unwell.
string: 你还好吗？看着不太舒服。

original: You're lucky I saved this potion. It should help with your illness.
string: 算你走运，我留着这瓶药水。应该对你的病有用。

original: You're lucky I saved this potion, love. Drink it and be healthy again.
string: 算你走运，我留着这瓶药水，亲爱的。喝下去，快点好起来。

original: Fine choice of weapon. Though I suppose I'll make up for your lack of skills.
string: 武器挑得不错。不过你缺的那点本事，就由我来补吧。

original: You use that weapon rather well. Perhaps we can indeed complement each other in battle.
string: 你使那件武器使得相当好。也许我们确实能在战斗里互补。

original: I have yet to see someone who uses a weapon as proficiently as you. Except when I look at a mirror, that is.
string: 我还从没见过有人用武器用得跟你一样熟练。当然，除了我照镜子的时候。

original: You swing that weapon like a troll trying to dance. I wouldn't bother trying if I were you.
string: 你挥那武器像头巨魔在跳舞。换作我，压根不会去试。

original: I fail to see why you would carry a hunk of metal into a fight. By the time you get close enough to swing it, you're already spent.
string: 我看不出你为什么要把那么一大块铁带进战斗里。等你好不容易靠近到能挥得动它，力气早就用完了。

original: I'm impressed. You can walk miles with that hunk of metal and still keep fighting.
string: 我服了。你扛着那一大块铁走几里路，还能接着打。

original: Where you lack in agility, you more than make up for it with brute strength. Perhaps we complement each other in some ways.
string: 你敏捷上缺的东西，全靠蛮力补了回来。也许在某些方面我们彼此互补。

original: Your arrows may hit your mark, but they don't always strike where it hurts most.
string: 你的箭或许能射中目标，但未必总能射到最致命的地方。

original: You shoot like a true huntsman - deadly and precise. I can respect that.
string: 你射箭像个真正的猎手——既致命又精准。这点我敬重。

original: Light armor is practical. Still, you need to learn that its greatest value is not in the defense, but the agility.
string: 轻甲讲究实用。不过你得明白，它最大的价值不在防御，而在灵活。

original: Agile as the wind and cunning like a fox. You wear your armor well.
string: 迅如疾风，狡如狐狸。你把这身甲穿出了名堂。

original: I'm surprised you can even run in that armor.
string: 你穿着那身甲居然还能跑，真让我意外。

original: You are an impregnable fortress.
string: 你就是一座攻不破的堡垒。

original: Potions are always useful. So is poison. Our journey will have great need of your alchemy skills, to be sure.
string: 药水总是有用。毒药也一样。这一路上，你的炼金手艺必定大有用处。

original: The right enchantment can change a battle's outcome. Sometimes, a war's. It is a powerful skill you have acquired.
string: 合适的附魔能改变一场战斗的结局。有时甚至能改变一场战争。你学到的这门本事很不简单。

original: Sapphire.
string: 蓝宝石。

original: I do see myself on her.
string: 我在她身上确实看见了自己。

original: Something dark holds her past and chains her future. It is a shadow she cannot escape from - not without help.
string: 有什么阴暗的东西攥着她的过去，锁住她的未来。那是她逃不掉的阴影——除非有人帮她。

original: Unless she learns to embrace it - like I did.
string: 除非她学会拥抱它——就像我一样。

original: Faralda.
string: 法劳达。

original: I wonder why the Professor would travel with us, given the researches and lectures she needs to conduct.
string: 我不明白，这位教授还有研究和讲座要做，为什么还要跟我们同行。

original: But who am I to argue? After all, I've never been an academic myself.
string: 但这事我有什么好争的？毕竟我自己从来不是个做学问的人。

original: Eli. (Elisif)
string: 伊莉。（艾利西弗）

original: I may be no mage, but I can still see the traces of magic on her face.
string: 我虽不是法师，可我还是能看见她脸上魔法的痕迹。

original: What is she hiding? Why go to such lengths to pretend to be someone else?
string: 她在隐瞒什么？为什么要费这么大功夫假装成另一个人？

original: I can but hope you harbor the same suspicion, and aren't protecting someone else's secrets from me.
string: 我只能指望你也抱着同样的怀疑，而不是在替别人瞒着我什么。

original: I don't know if you harbor the same suspicion, or if you're protecting her secrets from me. It matters little either way.
string: 我不知道你是否也有同样的怀疑，还是你在替她瞒着我。不管哪种，都没什么要紧。

original: For a noblewoman to brave crypts and bandit lairs with us, her reason must be peculiar indeed.
string: 一个贵族女子敢跟我们闯墓穴、进强盗窝，她图的东西一定古怪得很。

original: Lisette.
string: 莉赛蒂。

original: The way her delicate fingers moved as she played her lute, how she loved art and lived by it...
string: 她拨弄鲁特琴时，那纤细的手指怎么动，她多么爱艺术、多么为艺术而活……

original: She reminds me of Adara. The one I once loved.
string: 她让我想起了阿达拉。我曾经爱过的那个人。

original: She's a fine bard. Reminds me of someone from another life.
string: 她是个好诗人。让我想起另一段人生里的某个人。

original: Do you have feelings for her?
string: 你对她动心了吗？

original: When you are right beside me? Hardly.
string: 你就站在我旁边，怎么可能。

original: I'm not sure. I guess time will tell... Come on, let's get moving.
string: 我说不准。让时间给答案吧……走吧，动身了。

original: So...
string: 那么……

original: Well...
string: 好吧……

original: Hmm...
Motherhood is... strange. I've only known these tiny souls for a fragment of my years, yet I would lay down my life to protect our children.
string: 为人母……很奇怪。我只认识这些小小的灵魂短短数年，但我愿为了保护我们的孩子献出生命。

original: Motherhood is... strange. I've only known this tiny soul for a fragment of my years, yet I would lay down my life to protect our child.
string: 为人母……很奇怪。我只认识这个小小的灵魂短短数年，但我愿为了保护我们的孩子献出生命。

original: Having now a child of my own... I think I can understand how my mother felt, when she died to save me from the An-Xileel.
string: 现在有了自己的孩子……我想我能理解母亲当年的感受了，那时她为了保护我免受安西尔族伤害而牺牲。

original: Having now children of my own... I think I can understand how my mother felt, when she died to save me from the An-Xileel.
string: 现在有了自己的孩子……我想我能理解母亲当年的感受了，那时她为了保护我免受安-西里尔伤害而牺牲。

original: It's late, love... Talk in the morning?
string: 不早了，亲爱的……明早再聊？

original: I prayed to Azura for your return, and the Twilight Goddess delivered.
string: 我向阿祖拉祈祷你的归来，而黄昏女神回应了我的祈愿。

original: I don't know how you manage out there without me. The fights, you can handle... but the loneliness? That's what's unbearable.
string: 我不知道没有我你是怎么在外应付的。战斗你能应付……但孤独呢？那才是难以忍受的。

original: How long are you planning to stay home this time? Whatever it is... make it longer.
string: 这次你打算在家待多久？不管多久……再长点吧。

original: I've prepared some dishes per Dunmeri traditions. I hope you find them... agreeable.
string: 我准备了一些符合丹莫传统的菜肴。希望你觉得……合胃口。

original: The kids seem to loathe the food I made, except the pies and the cakes. One day, I'll teach them to appreciate genuine Morrowind cuisine yet.
string: 孩子们似乎很讨厌我做的食物，除了派和蛋糕。总有一天，我会教会他们欣赏真正的晨风美食。

original: Our child seems to loathe the food I made, except the pies and cakes. One day, I'll teach the young one to appreciate genuine Morrowind cuisine yet.
string: 我们的孩子似乎很讨厌我做的食物，除了派和蛋糕。总有一天，我会教会小家伙欣赏真正的晨风美食。

original: Dunmeri food can be harsh to the tongue... if done correctly. But I trust we can find a common ground between taste and tradition, hmm?
string: 丹莫食物可能很刺激味蕾……如果做得正宗的话。但我相信我们能在口味和传统之间找到共同点，嗯？

original: Why don't you take a shower first, my love? The roads must be rough on you... and your aroma is rough on our house.
string: 亲爱的，你先去洗个澡怎么样？旅途一定很辛苦……而且你身上的味道对咱们家来说有点冲。

original: Our child hates bathing, but the story about the skeever always does the trick. Maybe I'll tell you that someday.
string: 我们的孩子讨厌洗澡，但关于恶鼠的故事总是管用。也许哪天我会讲给你听。

original: The kids hate bathing, but the story about the skeever always gets them to obey. Maybe I'll tell you that someday.
string: 孩子们讨厌洗澡，但关于恶鼠的故事总是能让他们听话。也许哪天我会讲给你听。

original: First rule of my house - no one skips the bath.
string: 我家的第一条规矩——谁都不许不洗澡。

original: All the skills I've learned, and you'd have me be the housewife. Not that I don't appreciate the quiet and peace.
string: 我学了这么多技能，你却让我当家庭主妇。不是说我不享受这份宁静和平和。

original: It's... strange, to finally sleep with both my eyes shut. This life will take some adjusting to.
string: 终于能闭着双眼睡觉……感觉有点奇怪。这种生活还需要适应一下。

original: Maybe I'll teach the young ones to use swords. That just might save their lives one day.
string: 也许我会教小家伙们用剑。说不定哪天能救他们的命。

original: Maybe I'll teach our child to use a sword. That just might be the most useful skill to have these days.
string: 也许我会教我们的孩子用剑。这可能是如今最有用的技能了。

original: Do you think our child likes sword better, or bow and arrows? Never mind. I'll just teach both.
string: 你觉得我们的孩子更喜欢剑，还是弓和箭？算了。我两个都教。

original: Do you think the kids like sword better, or bow and arrows? Never mind. I'll just teach them both.
string: 你觉得孩子们更喜欢剑，还是弓和箭？算了。我两个都教。

original: I doubt our child will ever fight as well as I do... But what matters is that the young one can survive out there.
string: 我怀疑我们的孩子永远无法像我一样战斗……但重要的是小家伙能在外面生存下来。

original: I doubt our kids will ever fight as well as I do... But what matters is they can survive out there.
string: 我怀疑孩子们永远无法像我一样战斗……但重要的是他们能在外面生存下来。

original: When I was a child, I dreamt that I had a big mansion, soft beds, and endless toys. I didn't get what I wished... but I'm glad our child does.
string: 小时候，我梦想拥有大宅邸、柔软的床和无休止的玩具。我没得到想要的……但我很高兴我们的孩子得到了。

original: When I was a child, I dreamt that I had a big mansion, soft beds, and endless toys. I didn't get what I wished... but I'm glad our kids do.
string: 小时候，我梦想拥有大宅邸、柔软的床和无休止的玩具。我没得到想要的……但我很高兴孩子们得到了。

original: Maybe I'll teach the kids how to paint or write poems. If they do well with their martial training, that is.
string: 也许我会教孩子们画画或写诗。前提是他们的武术训练得不错。

original: Maybe I'll teach our child how to paint or write poems. If the young one does well with the martial training, that is.
string: 也许我会教我们的孩子画画或写诗。前提是小家伙的武术训练得不错。

original: You should've seen it. Our child took down a mudcrab with but a wooden sword. The little one truly inherited from the best.
string: 你真该看看。我们的孩子只用一把木剑就干掉了一只泥沼蟹。小家伙真是继承了最优秀的基因。

original: You should've seen it. The kids took down a giant mudcrab with nothing but wooden swords. They did inherit from the best, no?
string: 你真该看看。孩子们只用木剑就干掉了一只巨大的泥沼蟹。他们确实继承了最优秀的基因，不是吗？

original: The young one tried my mead while I wasn't aware and passed out till the next sunset. I don't think our child will want a drop of mead anytime soon.
string: 小家伙趁我不注意尝了我的蜜酒，结果昏睡到第二天日落。我想我们的孩子短期内不会再想碰一滴蜜酒了。

original: One of the kids tried my mead while I wasn't aware and passed out till the next sunset. I doubt our child will want a drop of mead anytime soon.
string: 其中一个孩子趁我不注意尝了我的蜜酒，结果昏睡到第二天日落。我想我们的孩子短期内不会再想碰一滴蜜酒了。

original: There are many kids in Whiterun. Our children must know how to defend themselves from bullies.
string: 白漫城有很多孩子。我们的孩子必须知道如何保护自己免受欺负。

original: I don't like the women in the Bannered Mare. They always gave me that weird gaze.
string: 我不喜欢悬旗母马里的女人。她们总是用那种奇怪的眼神看我。

original: Our child has been pestering me about Dragonsreach. Why don't you take the little one to the castle and see the Jarl someday?
string: 我们的孩子一直在缠着我问龙临宫的事。哪天你带小家伙去城堡见见领主怎么样？

original: Windhelm's Nords have been bothering our children, mocking their "gray-skin" mother. Maybe I should do something about it.
string: 风舵城的诺德人一直在骚扰我们的孩子，嘲笑他们"灰皮肤"的母亲。也许我该为此做点什么。

original: This house seems quiet and warm now, but its history always looms around us.
string: 这房子现在看似宁静温暖，但它的历史始终笼罩着我们。

original: You are the only thing that keeps me warm in this wretched city.
string: 在这座可恶的城市里，你是我唯一的温暖。

original: You are the only thing that keeps me warm in this wretched city. You, and our young.
string: 在这座可恶的城市里，你是我唯一的温暖。你，还有我们的孩子。

original: I think it's a mistake for me to live in Windhelm again, but I trust you moved us here for a reason.
string: 我觉得再次住在风舵城是个错误，但我相信你把我们搬来这里是有原因的。

original: Solitude is a fair city to raise a child.
string: 独孤城是个适合养育孩子的好城市。

original: Maybe we should take the kids to the Bards College more often. Soak in the culture and art, hmm?
string: 也许我们应该多带孩子们去吟游诗人学院。沉浸在文化和艺术中，嗯？

original: The sea wind may be cold, but our hearth will always keep us warm.
string: 海风可能很冷，但我们的炉火会永远保持温暖。

original: It's quite soothing to hear the bards practice their music. What pleasant neighbors.
string: 听吟游诗人练习音乐相当令人舒心。真是不错的邻居。

original: I think many of my Dunmer brethren will appreciate Solitude too.
string: 我想我的许多丹莫同胞也会喜欢独孤城的。

original: We've worked so hard to earn this house for our family. Our children need to know this fact.
string: 我们为了给家人赢得这所房子付出了太多努力。我们的孩子需要知道这一点。

original: We've worked so hard to earn this house for our family. Our child needs to know this fact.
string: 我们为了这个家辛辛苦苦才挣得这所房子。我们的孩子需要知道这一点。

original: This city is no place to raise a family.
string: 这座城市不适合养育家庭。

original: Unless you want to raise a little Forsworn, I'd suggest we move elsewhere.
string: 除非你想养大一个小弃誓者，否则我建议我们搬去别处。

original: As much as I enjoy your company, my back hurts every time I wake up... Who came up with the idea to make beds out of stone?
string: 虽然我很喜欢有你陪伴，但每次醒来我的背都疼……是谁想出用石头做床的主意的？

original: Even with the priestesses of Dibella, Markarth will never feel like home to me.
string: 即使有迪贝拉的女祭司们，马卡斯城也永远无法让我感到像家一样。

original: To Oblivion with blood and silver. I can barely stand the stone and Dwemer.
string: 让银血都见鬼去吧。我简直受不了这里的石头和锻莫风格。

original: Riften reminds me of my childhood "home", you know... And that's not a good sign.
string: 裂谷城让我想起了我童年的“家”，你知道的……这并不是什么好兆头。

original: Must we really make home at Riften? Surely, there are better... cleaner places to sleep in?
string: 我们真的必须在裂谷城安家吗？肯定有更好……更干净的地方可以睡觉吧？

original: The house is fine enough... but soon as we step outside, that mirage is broken.
string: 房子倒是不错……但只要一走出门，那幻象就破灭了。

original: Your Guild relations aside... why would you possibly want to live in Riften, what with its sewers and its slums?
string: 抛开你的公会关系不谈……你怎么会想住在裂谷城呢，那里可是有下水道和贫民窟的？

original: Riften is no place to raise a child, unless you want a little pickpocket.

string: 湖景宜人，森林提供了很好的运动场所。还要什么呢？

string: 前几天我和孩子们去钓鱼了。晚餐吃了一条巨大的鱼……真可惜你错过了。

string: 如果我们继续住在这里，很快我们每晚都得吃泥沼蟹当晚餐了。

original: I don't care for the vampires in the swamps, but I've had enough of creatures like mudcrabs and spiders.
string: 我不喜欢沼泽里的吸血鬼，但我已经受够了像泥沼蟹和蜘蛛这样的生物。

string: 这沼泽里的潮湿让人无法忍受。说真的，我们到底为什么要住在这里？

string: 就在前几天，我醒来时腿上全是包。阿祖拉诅咒那些蚊子。

string: 这片土地冷极了！我当然能适应，但我们的孩子呢？

string: 偶尔出现的雪熊和狼我能应付，但这寒冷我该怎么办？

string: 前几天我们的孩子打跑了一个欺负人的家伙。我为这个小战士感到无比自豪。

string: 穿着这身盔甲做家务、喂我们的孩子……有时候感觉确实有点奇怪。

string: 家庭生活并非我所预期，但这正是我梦寐以求的。

string: 是的，妻子？

string: 亲爱的。

string: 你永远将是我最珍爱的人。

string: 你怎么敢伤害我的妻子？我会让你痛苦不堪！

string: 睡得好吗，亲爱的？

string: 床有点晃了。我在考虑哪天换一张。

original: What a night... my love.
string: 真是难忘的一夜……亲爱的。

string: 我想当我们践行她的艺术时，迪贝拉都害羞了。

string: 你喜欢我的“艺术”吗，亲爱的？

original: Let us make great art again when the next moons rise.
string: 待下一轮月升之时，让我们再次共创伟大的艺术吧。

string: 噢，亲爱的……希望孩子们没听见我们的动静。

string: 噢，亲爱的……希望我们的孩子没听见我们的动静。

string: 也许我去给我们做些早餐。希望你会喜欢灰烬的风味……

original: I scouted a bit while you were resting. All's clear for now.
string: 你休息时我去侦察了一番。目前一切平安。

string: 你睡觉时我杀了几只恶鼠。真是讨厌的生物。

original: Had a good dream, I hope?
string: 希望做了个好梦？

original: Come on. We still have battles to fight.
string: 走吧。还有战斗要打。

original: Let's go. There's still much to do.
string: 走吧。还有好多事要做。

original: I wonder if you dreamt of me.
string: 我好奇你有没有梦到我。

string: 我几乎没怎么休息。

string: 你说我们'休息'的时候，是不是吵醒了一两个尸鬼？

string: 平安回家，亲爱的。

string: 回家时带些新的睡前故事回来，嗯？

string: 下次你回来时，我会想些新的方式来练习我们的“艺术”。

original: The mead made the Nords complacent, feeble. Maybe they deserve to live in the wilds like the savages their ancestors were.
string: 蜂蜜酒让诺德人变得自满而虚弱。也许他们活该像祖先那样如野蛮人般生活在荒野之中。

original: I like mead well enough, but I wouldn't drink here if I were you. Who knows what the Rieklings had... released into the barrels?
string: 我挺喜欢蜂蜜酒的，但如果是你，我可不会在这里喝。谁知道瑞克灵往木桶里……释放了什么？

original: A dead general coming to reconquer this island? How typically Imperial.
string: 一个死掉的将军要来重新征服这座岛屿？真是典型的帝国人作风。

original: Looks like Dunmer magicks are at work here. Could it be the plot of one of our own?
string: 看起来是丹莫魔法在作祟。难道是我们自己人之一的阴谋？

original: A majestic being once reigned here. The throne itself should be telling enough.
string: 曾经有一位威严的存在统治于此。王座本身便足以说明一切。

original: That was a great specter you've slain. I can almost hear the glacier singing your glory... Just metaphorically, of course.
string: 你斩杀的那个幽魂可真了不起。我几乎能听到冰川在歌颂你的荣耀……当然是比喻意义上的。

original: Fancy destroying your enemies with magic, hmm? I never found the aptitude for it.
string: 想用魔法摧毁敌人，嗯？我从未发现自己有这方面的天赋。

string: 晨风的御火师利用红山的热量来增强他们的魔法。我在想你是否能利用天际的严寒做到同样的事。

original: Are you truly this handsome... or is that just an illusion spell, my love?
string: 你真的这么英俊……还是那只是幻术，亲爱的？

string: 你真的这么美丽……还是那只是幻术，亲爱的？

original: Perhaps you could make our enemies dance to your illusion spells. That would make a decent entertainment to supplement the killing.
string: 也许你可以让我们的敌人随着你的幻术咒语起舞。那会成为杀戮之余不错的娱乐。

original: I can think of a few creative uses for your illusion spells... Care to indulge me next time?
string: 我能想到你的幻术咒语的一些创造性用途……下次愿意满足我吗？

original: Magic armor may be simplistic and unassuming, but it's useful and effective.
string: 魔法护甲可能简单且不起眼，但它实用且有效。

original: I tolerate your necromancy, but don't expect me to appreciate it.
string: 我容忍你的死灵法术，但别指望我会欣赏它。

original: The dead should never be returned to the living. I have little love for your necromancy spells.
string: 死者绝不应回归生者之列。我对你的死灵法术咒语没什么好感。

original: Consorting with Oblivion seldom conjures good omens. I hope you know what you're doing.
string: 与湮灭为伍很少会带来好的预兆。我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: You may think yourself the master of your thralls, but in truth, you've made yourself a slave to Oblivion.
string: 你可能自认为是奴仆的主人，但实际上，你已让自己成为了湮灭的奴隶。

original: Healing magic is seldom given the appreciation it deserves. I think it's an art worthy of veneration.
string: 治疗魔法很少得到应有的赏识。我认为它是一种值得尊崇的艺术。

original: Your hands can kill, yet they can also save lives. I think it's the greatest irony of life.
string: 你的双手可以杀戮，也可以拯救生命。我认为这是生命最大的讽刺。

string: 把孩子们独自留在家中感觉不太对劲。

string: 把我们的孩子独自留在家中感觉不太对劲。

string: 回来看小家伙了，是吗？

string: 也许当我们肉体消逝时，我们会加入群星之列。我希望我的星星永远在你身边。
